TextView.android:text: Choose what types of places to include.
Tip: uncheck Attractions to filter out commercial venues.

Caps how many places famous mode pulls from the map in a single search. A small number loads faster but can miss famous points of interest; a larger number is more thorough but lengthens the initial load in famous mode.

Narration runs entirely on your device — no API key needed, completely free. Quality and style will be noticeably different from the cloud options, and narrations may take 15 to 60 seconds to generate depending on your device.

Deep Dive explores the original location from up to 10 different angles — a new story, person, or detail each time — without rabbit-trailing to other topics. Use {subject} as a placeholder for the place name and summary.

RadioButton.android:text: Android TTS (free, offline, instant, low quality)
OpenAI ($.04 per entry, online, high quality)
Kokoro (free, offline, high quality, long load times between entries)

TextView.android:text: Describe what happened or share your thoughts. Your device info, current settings, and app logs will be attached automatically.
Lets the AI search the web when no Wikipedia article exists for a place. May add a few seconds to narration generation.
Exports all places narrated this session in chronological order with timestamps.
Exports the full background-ranked list from the most recent fetch — use to audit the ranking algorithm.
Shows every POI whose Wikipedia/Wikidata match was rejected (denylist or name-mismatch). Review the list in-app, then export as TSV to audit false positives.
Copies recent narration and voice-engine log lines to the clipboard.
Copies the most recent 200 lines from the full app log to the clipboard.
Saves the complete app log to a file and opens the share sheet so you can send it back.
Saves logs captured while connected to Android Auto and opens the share sheet.
